description: This class includes activities that contribute to the completion or finishing of a construction.
includes: installation of doors, windows, door and window frames of wood or other materials
installation of fitted kitchens, staircases, shop fittings and the like
interior completion such as ceilings, wooden wall coverings, movable partitions
laying, tiling, hanging or fitting: tiles and flagstones, parquet and other wooden floor coverings
installation of external doors, internal partitions
provision of finishing service such as interior finishing (plasterboard, plastering, painting, floor laying)
excludes: installation of major kitchen appliances, see 4329
